description: ai-ecoverse/slicc-jsh#900: Node 22.22.0 reads -p and --print as a boolean: the next argument is its code only when it is there, not empty and does not start with -, so -p alone prints what stdin evaluates to and -p -1 is a bad option; --print=X and --no-print are the same option, -e after -p still prints, -- names the script, and an empty script reads stdin as - does
